title: VakilnaSEEG-fingerprint: sEEG seizure-onset and interictal segments of one polymicrogyria patient with electrode coordinates (Vakilna et al., 2025) (derivative)
description: Derivative sEEG dataset from a single patient with bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria and intractable focal seizures, comprising short seizure-onset and interictal segments in monopolar and bipolar montages. Channel locations for 228 depth-electrode contacts are included. The data come from a case study that applied time-frequency fingerprint analysis in source space to localize the epileptogenic zone, after which the patient was treated with MR-guided laser interstitial thermal therapy and became seizure-free.
methods_description: Clinical stereo-EEG was recorded with a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200A at 2000 Hz. The authors imported it into Brainstorm, notch-filtered the 180-900 Hz harmonics, and resampled to 1000 Hz. The segments were repackaged as BrainVision float32 in microvolts, with Brainstorm events converted to events.tsv and channel locations (SCS) to electrodes.tsv.
